rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive/FlagErrorf, prShared alias, WithRepoDir on Pull; but the requested reusable helper on git.Client is absent, replaced by a command-slice builder in pr/shared plus an ad-hoc runGitCommands loop in develop.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, --checkout requirement, --list exclusivity, Abs normalisation, symlink/other-repo/same-repo/nested-worktree rejection and ff-only pull with warning are all handled; reuse-existing-worktree case also covered.
rationale.scope: Feature and shared-package resolution delivered, but no git client helper as specified, and help text does not state the flag's constraints; checkout.go refactor is behaviour-preserving.
rationale.readability: Structure is clear, but doc comments on ensureWorktreePathSafe, revParseFacts and the reuse branch were dropped in the move; WorktreeCheckoutCommands returns an unnamed bool that callers must interpret.
rationale.robustness: Errors from worktree add/checkout propagate; pull failure degrades to a warning like the existing flow; validation runs before any API calls; no panics.
rationale.maintainability: Dedupes worktree logic between commands, yet WorktreeCheckoutCommands mixes a git query with command generation, checkout.go rebuilds WorktreeTarget instead of reusing it, and develop grows its own command runner.
